item.title: Charli xcx Joins The Strokes at Outside Lands to Sing an ‘Is This It’ Classic
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to Trending on Billboard!Today, we're talking about an epic collaboration that went down at San Francisco's Outside Lands festival. Charli XCX joined forces with The Strokes for an unforgettable performance.
[Cut to music clip: The Strokes - "Take It Or Leave It"]
Host: "On Saturday, August 8th, Charli XCX took the stage with The Strokes' frontman Julian Casablancas to perform the classic hit 'Take It Or Leave It' from their 2001 debut album 'Is This It'. Casablancas introduced Charli as 'a superstar', and even joked about their recent album releases, saying Charli's new LP 'Music, Fashion, Film' had beaten out The Strokes' 'Reality Awaits' on the Billboard 200 chart.
[Cut to music clip: Charli XCX - album snippet]
Host: "Charli XCX's album landed at number 3, while The Strokes' album arrived at number 13. Casablancas congratulated Charli on her win, saying 'She won by a lot. She's a giant pop star, in our defense'.
[Cut to music clip: The Strokes - album snippet]
Host: "The Strokes performed a career-spanning set, with tracks from 'Is This It', 'Room on Fire', and their new album 'Reality Awaits'. And Charli XCX wasn't the only surprise guest - she also made a cameo appearance during Djo's set, leaving a pre-recorded message for his song 'Charlie's Garden'.
[Cut to music clip: Djo - "Charlie's Garden"]
Host: "Charli XCX has spoken about her love for The Strokes in the past, even saying that their song 'I'll Try Anything Once' makes her cry. It's clear that this was a dream collaboration for her.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's it for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!"
